args: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=$GITHUB_PAT GITHUB_TOOLSETS=$GITHUB_TOOLSETS GITHUB_READ_ONLY=$GITHUB_READ_ONLY docker run -i --rm -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN -e GITHUB_TOOLSETS -e GITHUB_READ_ONLY ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server:v1.0.3
github.description: GitHub MCP via Docker (ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server pinned to v1.0.3). Requires GITHUB_PAT (fine-grained PAT, repo+pull-request+actions+read:org). Read-only by default; flip GITHUB_READ_ONLY=0 only for approved postback stages. See SETUP.md.
